roadmap.title: Finish the story
roadmap.description: Play through the campaign on any difficulty, keeping a backup save, and defeat the first Sweeper bot you meet.

roadmap.title: Shelter, collectibles and combat tasks
roadmap.description: Return to the finished save to talk to Diana, give REMs, finish Stamp Boards and Training Sims, find collectibles, and clear the combat challenges.

roadmap.title: Unknown Signal
roadmap.description: Get every sector to 100%, beat the four stronger bosses, clear all 10 Hidden Chamber missions, then finish with the Black Box mod equipped.

roadmap.title: Lunatic
roadmap.description: Start a fresh New Game on Lunatic and finish the story.

achievements.summary: Reach the Shelter in the story.

steps.text: Play the story until you arrive at the Shelter.

achievements.summary: Restore power in the story.

steps.text: Progress the story until the power is restored.

achievements.summary: Reach the Comms Tower in the story.

steps.text: Progress the story until you reach the @loc{Comms Tower}.

achievements.summary: Meet the trapped girl in the story.

steps.text: Progress the story until you meet the trapped girl.

achievements.summary: Get the stop code in the story.

steps.text: Progress the story until you obtain the stop code.

achievements.summary: Reach Nexus Tower in the story.

steps.text: Progress the story until you reach @loc{Nexus Tower}.

achievements.summary: Fix up Diana in the story.

steps.text: Progress the story until Diana is repaired.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Sentinel in the story.

steps.text: Progress the story to the @enemy{Sentinel} fight and defeat it.

achievements.summary: Complete the game on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the story and watch the ending.

achievements.displayName: The Right Man for the Job
achievements.summary: Complete Unknown Signal by clearing all 10 Hidden Chamber missions and finishing the game with the Black Box mod equipped.

guide.context: Unknown Signal adds post-story content to your finished save. Alpha is open from the start. Beta, Delta, Zeta and Theta open when you beat the stronger version of the Sector Guard, Creator, Garden Keeper and LunaDigger. Gamma, Epsilon, Eta, Iota and Kappa open when you reach 100% in Solar Power Plant, Mass Production Array, Terra Dome, Lunum Mines and Central Port.

steps.text: After the credits, enter Unknown Signal from the hub tram.
Get every sector to 100% and beat the four stronger bosses to unlock all 10 missions.
Clear all 10 Hidden Chamber missions to get the @item{Black Box} mod.
Equip @item{Black Box} before the final boss, then beat the stronger final boss and finish the game.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Lunatic difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Lunatic difficulty.

guide.context: Lunatic only appears when you start a New Game after your first clear. It is not offered in New Game Plus.

steps.text: Finish the story once, then start a fresh New Game and pick Lunatic.
Put upgrades into health and Diana's hack damage.
Use @item{Photon Laser}, @item{Charge Piercer}, @item{Jackhammer} and Critical Shot, and use Heat nodes in Combust Mode on normal enemies.
Enter the final boss with a full Deletion Protocol bar and attack from behind with the @item{Photon Laser}.

achievements.description: Talk to Diana in the Shelter.
achievements.summary: Talk to Diana in the Shelter.

steps.text: In the Shelter, pick the talk option with Diana again and again until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Receive a picture as a present.
achievements.summary: Receive a picture from Diana as a present.

guide.context: Diana gives 4 pictures in total, one at a time as you give her REMs.

steps.text: Give Diana REMs in the Shelter until she hands you a picture.

achievements.summary: Win a game of hide-and-seek with Diana in the Shelter.

guide.context: Hide-and-seek only appears after you have talked to Diana several times. Once it is open, you can play again whenever you talk to her.

steps.text: Talk to Diana in the Shelter until hide-and-seek unlocks.
Play and find her to win.

achievements.description: Give an REM as a present.
achievements.summary: Give Diana one REM in the Shelter.

steps.text: Give Diana the first REM you found; it is picked up automatically.

achievements.summary: Complete one REM series by giving Diana every REM in that series.

steps.text: Collect the REMs of one series from the sectors.
Give them all to Diana in the Shelter until the series is complete.

achievements.summary: Complete one Cabin Stamp Board.

guide.context: Boards need 9, 16, 16 or 16 Cabin Coins. Coins come from Safe Boxes, giving REMs to Diana and Training Sims.

steps.text: Collect Cabin Coins.
Spend them at the Stamp Board until every tile of one board is revealed.

achievements.description: Complete the main objective in a Training Sim.
achievements.summary: Complete the main objective in one Training Sim.

steps.text: Open a Training Sim from the Shelter and finish its main objective (the gold diamond); side objectives are not needed.

achievements.description: Complete the main objective in every Training Sim.
achievements.summary: Complete the main objective in all 30 Training Sims.

guide.context: New Sims open through Shelter upgrades after bosses and through Training Data you find in the sectors.

steps.text: Finish the main objective in every Training Sim; side objectives are not needed.
If a Sim is missing, pick up the 6 Training Data in the sectors and check your Shelter upgrades.

achievements.summary: Secure a Red Zone.

guide.context: Red Gate Keys are single-use and can open any gate. Four lie in the world, starting in the Shopping District; the rest are bought at Cabin's Stamp Club with Cabin Coins.

steps.text: Get a Red Gate Key.
Open a Red Gate with the key and clear the Red Zone arena.

achievements.displayName: You're Not Getting Away That Easy
achievements.summary: Defeat a Sweeper bot.

guide.context: Sweepers are small floating enemies that appear rarely and unpredictably, so you may not get many chances. Make a backup save first.

steps.text: Look for a Sweeper in Mass Production Array areas 03 and 04 and Lunum Mines areas 02 and 03.
Defeat the first one you see; if it escapes, reload and try again.
Use @item{Overdrive Protocol} or @item{Stasis Net} to make it easier to hit.

achievements.summary: Find a Holo-Wall.

steps.text: Look for suspicious walls where collectibles seem to be missing, especially ones that flicker with blue dots.
Interact with the wall to remove the hologram.

achievements.summary: Shoot one Mini Cabin.

guide.context: Mini Cabins make a sound when you are near. There are 3 in each of the 5 sectors.

steps.text: Listen for the noise in a sector, find the Mini Cabin and shoot it.

achievements.summary: Shoot all 15 Mini Cabins.

guide.context: Each sector hides 3. If you skip one, return for it once the story is over, in Unknown Signal.

steps.text: Find and shoot the 3 Mini Cabins in every sector.

achievements.description: Upgrade a weapon using Pure Lunum.
achievements.summary: Upgrade a weapon with Pure Lunum.

steps.text: Take a Pure Lunum to the Shelter printer.
Spend it on a weapon upgrade.

achievements.description: Print all obtainable weapons, hacking nodes, and abilities during the main story.
achievements.summary: Print every obtainable weapon, hacking node and ability during the main story.

guide.context: Level 1 of each is enough. If it does not unlock, check that Autohacking is printed too.

steps.text: Open the printer in the Shelter and print each weapon, hacking node and ability that is available.
Check Stamp Board rewards and story progress for any that are still missing.

achievements.description: Reach 100% sector progress in a sector.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% progress in one sector.

guide.context: Training Data, Cartridge Holders, Storage Expanders, Mods, REMs, Pure Lunum and Safe Boxes all count toward the percentage. Mini Cabins and Escape Hatches are tracked separately. Red Zone reward chests can hold counted items.

steps.text: Collect every counted item in one sector until its progress shows 100%.

achievements.summary: Unlock every Escape Hatch.

guide.context: There are 27 Escape Hatches across the sectors. They do not count toward a sector's 100%.

steps.text: Find and open every Escape Hatch in all five sectors.

achievements.description: Complete a mission in a special sector.
achievements.summary: Complete a mission in a special sector.

guide.context: This is the first Unknown Signal mission, which is available as soon as you finish the story.

steps.text: After the story, enter Unknown Signal from the hub tram.
Clear the Alpha mission.

achievements.description: Defeat three enemies at the same time with the Lim Recycler.
achievements.summary: Defeat three enemies at the same time with the Lim Recycler.

steps.text: Go to the yellow-plate room in Mass Production Array area 05, or play Training Simulation 10.
Group three enemies and kill them together with the @item{Lim Recycler}.

achievements.description: Repel the LunaDigger while progressing through the Lunum Mines.
achievements.summary: Make the LunaDigger retreat in Lunum Mines.

guide.context: You do not have to destroy it.

steps.text: Progress through Lunum Mines until the LunaDigger attacks.
Drop to the ground to lure it out and keep damaging it until it flees; stay away from the sparkles on the ground.

achievements.description: Confuse a certain enemy and borrow its shield.
achievements.summary: Confuse a Defender bot and take its shield.

steps.text: In Lunum Mines area 03, hack a Defender bot with Diana.
Run the hack through a Confuse node to take its shield.

achievements.description: Cleanse three or more enemies at the same time.
achievements.summary: Cleanse three or more corrupted enemies at the same time.

steps.text: Wait until three corrupted enemies are close together; Central Port has many chances.
Hold L1 to cleanse and release when all three are in range.

achievements.description: Deal 6000 gunshot damage in one second.
achievements.summary: Deal 6000 gunshot damage in one second.

steps.text: Fully charge the @item{Charge Piercer} in Training Mission 07.
Fire it through three or more bots in a line.

achievements.description: Deal 3000 hacking damage in a single hack.
achievements.summary: Deal 3000 hacking damage in a single hack.

guide.context: The final encounter has a scripted hack that deals over 30,000 damage if you are stuck.

steps.text: Use Offense Mode and build up a strong hack, for example in the Crack & Crash Training Sim.
Trigger it on a group so the total passes 3000.
